id.description: Unique identifier for this Action Plan Item. Use as the {id} path parameter to show, update, delete, or move the item.
Unique identifier for this Action Plan Item Assignee.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this assignee was created.

is_holding.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the assignee is necessary to sign for a hold point

is_locked.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the assignee was added prior to an Action Plan's approval

role.description: Organizational role of this assignee on the Action Plan Item.

role_id.description: ID of the role record assigned to this assignee. Null when the assignee was added by party rather than by role.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this assignee was last updated.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this item was created. Use with filters[created_at] for date-range filtering.

description.description: Detailed description of the work or inspection required for this Action Plan Item.

due_at.description: Due date for this item in ISO 8601 format. Null if no due date has been set. Use with filters[due_at] for deadline-based filtering.

holding_type.description: Action Plan Item holding type specifies whether the current item holds all the succeeding items in the section or the plan

is_blocked.description: Indicates whether current Action Plan Item is blocked by another Action Plan Item

is_blocking.description: Indicates whether current Action Plan Item is blocking other Action Plan Items

notes.description: Free-text notes attached to this Action Plan Item.

plan_id.description: ID of the Action Plan this item belongs to. Use with filters[plan_id] to list all items in a specific plan.

position.description: Ordinal position of this item within its section. Items are displayed in ascending position order.

plan_section_id.description: ID of the section this item belongs to within the Action Plan. Use with filters[plan_section_id] to list items in a specific section.

title.description: Short title summarizing the inspection or task for this Action Plan Item.

id.description: Unique identifier for the item status.

name.description: Name of the status. Possible values: open, in_progress, delayed, closed.

template_item_id.description: ID of the plan template item this item was generated from. Null if the item was created directly rather than from a template.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this item was last updated. Use with filters[updated_at] for change-based polling.

title.description: Title of the Action Plan Item

description.description: Description of the Action Plan Item

notes.description: Notes for the Action Plan Item

due_at.description: Due Date of the Action Plan Item

holding_type.description: Action Plan Item holding type specifies whether the current item holds all the succeeding items in the section or the plan

status_id.description: Status ID of the Action Plan Item (1 - open, 2 - in_progress, 3 - delayed, 4 - closed)
